paper_title: Evaluation of Speaker Anonymization on Emotional Speech
caption: Original distribution of emotion categories in the IEMOCAP dataset. Percentages are displayed with respect to number of utterances.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates a distribution of emotion categories within a dataset. The chart is divided into six slices, representing Anger, Sadness, Excitement, Happiness, Neutral, and Frustration. These segments are rendered in orange, brown, pink, red, blue, and light blue respectively. Percentage labels are provided inside each slice: Anger is 14.9%, Sadness is 14.7%, Excitement is 14.1%, Happiness is 8.1%, Neutral is 23.1%, and Frustration is 25.1%. A legend is present, identifying each color with its corresponding emotion category. The slices appear ordered visually by descending size, from Frustration to Neutral to Anger/Sadness/Excitement/Happiness.
